title: Ignored paths
description: Source the repo owner chose not to test. rules.ts skips these files as `ignored`, and both packages' vitest configs leave them out of coverage. The workflow reads this file from the base branch, so a PR cannot ignore its own code.

paths.description: Globs relative to the package folder, as vitest's coverage.exclude takes them, e.g. src/design-system/**.

reason.description: Why it is not tested; shown next to each skipped file in the Report.
